about_short_description.short_description: Maisarah Islamic Banking Services offers Sharia-compliant personal, business, and investment banking solutions.

product.name: Islamic Retail Finance
product.description: Sharia-compliant financing for personal needs, including homes, vehicles, property, goods, education, travel and other consumer requirements.

product.name: Islamic Accounts
product.description: Sharia-compliant deposit and transaction accounts for everyday banking, savings, targeted customer segments and business needs.

product.name: Islamic Deposits
product.description: Savings and term-deposit solutions that allow customers to hold funds in Omani rials or major foreign currencies under Sharia-compliant arrangements.

product.name: Islamic Credit Cards
product.description: Sharia-compliant Mastercard credit cards for purchases, online transactions, cash advances and supplementary cards, with rewards and payment protections.

product.name: Islamic Debit Cards
product.description: Debit cards linked to Dhofar Islamic accounts for ATM access, point-of-sale purchases and other card-based payment transactions.

product.name: SME Banking and Finance
product.description: Sharia-compliant banking and financing solutions for small and medium-sized enterprises, including accounts, working capital, Murabaha and asset-based facilities.
